analysis.scope: Qualification scenarios cover ALL remaining regular-season weeks (12-14) and are exhaustive: every one of the 2^18 = 262,144 win/loss combinations was evaluated. Week 12 scenarios cover the upcoming week only.
assumptions: Standings and schedules are as of Week 11 final; Week 12 has not been played (source check 2026-11-25 20:42 UTC).

Every remaining regular-season game (Weeks 12-14) is assumed to have a winner. Yahoo can record a tied game (W-L-T, counted as half a win in win percentage); ties are NOT enumerated. If any game ends tied, rerun the analysis.

Future fantasy scores are unknown. Whenever a team can finish tied at the cutoff, the result is marked TIEBREAKER-DEPENDENT; current points-for leads are shown for information only and are never treated as a guaranteed tiebreaker win.
An exact tie in season points for (after the primary tiebreaker) is not modeled; the tiebreaker order beyond points for is not documented.
unresolved: Yahoo's regular-season seeding tiebreaker is not shown on its settings page; points for is taken from the CFN site ranking and the league owner's confirmation.

Yahoo does not (yet) show a clinched marker for Love Thy Nabers; this analysis finds it mathematically clinched: it cannot finish below 9 wins, and six other teams cannot all reach 9 because Money O and The Bowery would both have to beat cuadz build 002 (Weeks 12 and 13), which caps cuadz build 002 at 8 wins.
analysis.method: Exhaustive enumeration of all 262,144 win/loss outcomes of the 18 remaining games; per team, conditions are rendered exactly (threshold conditions on other teams' final win totals, expanded to the specific games they must lose) and checked by an independent verifier for soundness and completeness.
notes: POSSIBLE is not used for this league: every path is fully specified.
